general.problemHelpText: Please describe the problem as clearly as possible – what it involves and when it occurred. The more information you provide, the better we can resolve the issue.
general.fileUploadLabel: Please feel free to attach a photo showing the fault (optional)
general.contactHelpText: Please let us know who we can contact if we need further information or have any questions regarding the fault report.

info.title: Information
info.text1: Important to bear in mind. Please describe the fault as clearly as possible and state where it is located (building, floor, room). The more information you provide, the quicker we can help you. Please feel free to attach a photo if this helps.
info.text2: Once your fault report has been registered, it will be handled by the property management team. Issues are assessed and prioritised based on their urgency and the impact the fault has on operations. We may contact you if we need further information or to arrange a time for the work to be carried out.
info.text3: In the event of an emergency (e.g. a water leak, power cut or danger to life or property), please contact the switchboard by telephone (090-16 10 00) rather than reporting the fault via the portal. They will ensure that the right person is contacted immediately and that action is taken straight away.

info.title: Information
general: Here you can order various services relating to the municipality's premises and properties, for example minor construction work, practical services and operational support.
Which orders are available depends on the building you select. Once you have chosen a building, the services that can be ordered for that property are shown.
buildingService: Byggservice carries out minor construction and fitting work, such as installing shelves, hooks, mouldings and noticeboards, as well as simple painting jobs.

Please note! Purely electrical work is not carried out by Byggservice (such as the installation of additional sockets or lighting) but must be ordered via Proceedo. The client (usually the unit manager) is responsible for the working environment, even when work is carried out by an external contractor.

Once your order has been submitted, Byggservice will make an initial assessment of the feasibility of your request; if necessary, the responsible property manager will also be consulted. A site visit is then often booked to assess the scope of the work, for example, before a decision is made on whether or not to proceed with the order.
Ensure that your description is as clear as possible to avoid the need for further information, and that your contact details are correct.
facilityService: Our caretakers work at a number of Umeå municipality's schools, preschools and residential care homes. Among other things they put up shelves and pictures, move furniture and carry out similar minor tasks. See the responsibility list (gränsdragningslistan) for more information.
townHallService: Stadshusservice is responsible for operational services within the city hall area. Submit a fault report or an order to Stadshusservice if you need help in the city hall area with updating signage, emptying cardboard recycling, mounting shelves, curtains or pictures, adding furniture or fixing faults in the meeting rooms (for example technical equipment).

building.notSupported: The selected building does not support requests for changed space requirements. Please choose another building.

info.title: Information
paragraphs: Describe the operation's space requirement as clearly as possible and choose the category that best matches the matter.
If the need is tied to a specific building, we recommend stating the building in the matter. If a suitable building has not yet been identified, the field can be left empty.

To ease the continued handling, it is valuable to attach relevant supporting material, for example investigations, decision documentation, drawings, images, or other documentation that clarifies the need.
Once the request is submitted, the matter is handled according to the municipality's space provision process.
